blocks.zh: 附錄A/B：危害識別問題清單與風險分析技術（FMEA/FTA）
blocks.en: Annex A/B: Hazard Identification Checklist and Risk Analysis Techniques (FMEA/FTA)

blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握附錄A的37個問題清單結構，能夠系統性識別醫療器材的潛在危害 / Use the Annex A question checklist to systematically identify hazards for any medical device
blocks.en: Use the Annex A question checklist to systematically identify hazards for any medical device

blocks.zh: 理解附錄B中五種風險分析技術（PHA、FTA、ETA、FMEA、HAZOP、HACCP）的各自適用場景 / Understand when to apply PHA, FTA, ETA, FMEA, HAZOP, and HACCP
blocks.en: Understand when to apply PHA, FTA, ETA, FMEA, HAZOP, and HACCP

blocks.zh: 掌握FMEA的「由下而上」與FTA的「由上而下」的根本差異 / Distinguish the bottom-up logic of FMEA from the top-down logic of FTA
blocks.en: Distinguish the bottom-up logic of FMEA from the top-down logic of FTA

blocks.zh: 能夠將CDMO無菌充填線的失效模式套入FMEA框架進行評估 / Apply FMEA to aseptic filling line failure modes in a CDMO context
blocks.en: Apply FMEA to aseptic filling line failure modes in a CDMO context

blocks.zh: 附錄A — 危害識別問題清單 / Annex A: Hazard Identification Checklist (p29–p36)
blocks.en: Annex A: Hazard Identification Checklist (p29-p36)

blocks.zh: 附錄A核心概念：危害識別是FMEA的前置步驟
blocks.en: Annex A core concept: hazard identification is the step before FMEA

blocks.zh: 附錄A的定位：FMEA之前的「危害腦力激盪」
blocks.en: Annex A's role: "hazard brainstorming" before FMEA

blocks.zh: 在進入FMEA工作表之前，風險管理團隊必須先回答一個問題：「這個醫療器材有哪些潛在的危害來源？」
blocks.en: Before moving to the FMEA worksheet, the risk management team must first answer one question: "What are the potential sources of hazard for this medical device?"

blocks.zh: 附錄A提供了一份結構化的問題清單，涵蓋：
blocks.en: Annex A provides a structured question checklist covering:

blocks.zh: 能量危害（電能、熱能、輻射、機械力）
blocks.en: Energy hazards (electrical, thermal, radiation, mechanical force)

blocks.zh: 生物性危害（滅菌失效、污染、組織相容性）
blocks.en: Biological hazards (sterilization failure, contamination, tissue compatibility)

blocks.zh: 環境危害（溫度、濕度、電磁干擾）
blocks.en: Environmental hazards (temperature, humidity, electromagnetic interference)

blocks.zh: 軟體與網路安全危害
blocks.en: Software and cybersecurity hazards

blocks.zh: 人因工程與使用錯誤危害
blocks.en: Human factors and use error hazards

blocks.zh: 廢棄物與處置危害
blocks.en: Waste and disposal hazards

blocks.zh: CDMO實踐：容器密封系統（CCI）的危害識別
blocks.en: CDMO practice: hazard identification for the container closure system (CCI)

blocks.zh: 以無菌藥品的容器密封系統為例，使用附錄A問題清單可系統性識別出：
blocks.en: Taking the container closure system of a sterile drug product as an example, the Annex A checklist can systematically identify:

blocks.zh: A.2.4（材料）→ 膠塞浸出物（Leachables）的化學危害
blocks.en: A.2.4 (materials) → chemical hazard from stopper leachables

blocks.zh: A.2.8（滅菌）→ 滅菌方法失效導致的微生物污染危害
blocks.en: A.2.8 (sterilization) → microbial contamination hazard from failure of the sterilization method

blocks.zh: A.2.22（壽命）→ 包材老化導致CCI失效的長期危害
blocks.en: A.2.22 (lifetime) → long-term hazard of CCI failure caused by packaging material aging

blocks.zh: A.2.14（非預期輸出）→ 微粒脫落（Particulate generation）危害
blocks.en: A.2.14 (unintended output) → particulate generation hazard

blocks.zh: 這些識別出的危害，直接轉化為後續FMEA的失效模式輸入。
blocks.en: These identified hazards feed directly into the failure modes of the subsequent FMEA.

blocks.zh: 重要提醒
blocks.en: Important reminder

blocks.zh: 清單是「輔助工具」，不是「完整清單」。製造商應根據具體器材的特性，增加或跳過相關問題。附錄A不能替代風險管理團隊的專業判斷。
blocks.en: The checklist is a "support tool," not a "complete list." Manufacturers should add or skip relevant questions according to the characteristics of the specific device. Annex A cannot replace the professional judgment of the risk management team.

blocks.zh: 附錄A問題清單的使用邏輯
blocks.en: How to use the Annex A question checklist

blocks.zh: 實例：無菌充填線的附錄A危害識別
blocks.en: Example: Annex A hazard identification for an aseptic filling line

blocks.zh: 針對一台預充填式注射器（PFS）充填線，使用附錄A依序提問：
blocks.en: For a prefilled syringe (PFS) filling line, work through Annex A in sequence:

blocks.zh: A.2.1：預期用途為靜脈注射藥品，支撐生命（癌症化療）→ 高嚴重性
blocks.en: A.2.1: Intended use is an intravenous drug that sustains life (cancer chemotherapy) → high severity

blocks.zh: A.2.4：針管材料為矽化玻璃，膠塞含鹵代丁基橡膠 → 需評估浸出物E&L
blocks.en: A.2.4: The barrel is siliconized glass and the plunger stopper contains halobutyl rubber → extractables and leachables (E&L) must be assessed

blocks.zh: A.2.5：無能量直接傳遞給患者，但充填設備的蠕動泵可能產生剪切力 → 蛋白質降解危害
blocks.en: A.2.5: No energy is delivered directly to the patient, but the peristaltic pump on the filling equipment may generate shear force → protein degradation hazard

blocks.zh: A.2.8：終端滅菌 vs. 無菌工藝 → 若為非終端滅菌，環境控制失效是主要危害
blocks.en: A.2.8: Terminal sterilization vs. aseptic process → if not terminally sterilized, failure of environmental control is the main hazard

blocks.zh: A.2.14：充填針磨損導致金屬微粒 → 顆粒危害
blocks.en: A.2.14: Wear of the filling needle produces metal particles → particulate hazard

blocks.zh: A.2.31：半自動充填操作員的疲勞與注意力分散 → 使用錯誤危害
blocks.en: A.2.31: Fatigue and distraction of operators in semi-automatic filling → use error hazard

blocks.zh: 以上識別出的危害，即成為後續FMEA工作表的「危害」欄位輸入。
blocks.en: The hazards identified above become the "Hazard" column input of the subsequent FMEA worksheet.

blocks.zh: A.2.31 人因工程問題的特殊重要性
blocks.en: The special importance of A.2.31 human factors questions

blocks.zh: 在無菌充填CDMO環境中，人因工程相關問題（A.2.31系列）尤為關鍵：
blocks.en: In an aseptic filling CDMO environment, human-factors questions (the A.2.31 series) are particularly critical:

blocks.zh: A.2.31.2（干擾）：無菌室內操作員需穿著全套無菌服，視野受限、溝通困難，干擾因素顯著
blocks.en: A.2.31.2 (distraction): Operators in the cleanroom must wear full aseptic gowning, with restricted vision and difficult communication, so distraction factors are significant

blocks.zh: A.2.31.3（連接部件）：充填針的連接、管路的快接介面，錯誤連接的後果
blocks.en: A.2.31.3 (connecting parts): Connection of filling needles and quick-connect interfaces on tubing; consequences of incorrect connection

blocks.zh: A.2.31.7（知識依賴）：資深操作員對生產線的依賴性評估，人員流動風險
blocks.en: A.2.31.7 (knowledge dependence): Assessing the line's dependence on senior operators, and the risk of staff turnover

blocks.zh: A.2.31.8（特殊用戶）：不同文化背景的操作員對SOP的理解差異
blocks.en: A.2.31.8 (special users): Differences in how operators from different cultural backgrounds understand SOPs

blocks.zh: 附錄A與ISO 14971:2019第5條的關係
blocks.en: Relationship between Annex A and Clause 5 of ISO 14971:2019

blocks.zh: ISO 14971:2019第5條「危害識別」要求製造商識別與醫療器材相關的「已知和可預見危害」。附錄A的問題清單是執行第5條要求的實務工具，但不是唯一方法。製造商可以：
blocks.en: Clause 5 of ISO 14971:2019, "Hazard identification," requires the manufacturer to identify the "known and foreseeable hazards" associated with the medical device. The Annex A checklist is a practical tool for meeting the Clause 5 requirement, but not the only method. The manufacturer may:

blocks.zh: 使用附錄A清單作為主要結構框架
blocks.en: Use the Annex A checklist as the main structural framework

blocks.zh: 補充臨床文獻、類似器材的事故報告
blocks.en: Supplement it with clinical literature and incident reports of similar devices

blocks.zh: 諮詢相關監管指引（如FDA的Design Considerations）
blocks.en: Consult relevant regulatory guidance (such as FDA's Design Considerations)

blocks.zh: 附錄B — 支援風險分析的技術 / Annex B: Techniques that Support Risk Analysis (p37–p43)
blocks.en: Annex B: Techniques that Support Risk Analysis (p37-p43)

blocks.zh: 附錄B：五種技術的定位地圖
blocks.en: Annex B: positioning map of the techniques

blocks.zh: 記憶口訣：「先掃描、再追根、再找效、再把關」
blocks.en: Memory aid: "Scan first, trace the root, find the effects, then guard"

blocks.zh:
PHA：開發初期「先掃描」所有潛在危害
FTA：有具體嚴重事件時「再追根」找原因
FMEA：設計成熟後「再找效」評估每個失效模式的影響
HAZOP：製程系統分析「找偏差」
HACCP：製造製程驗證「再把關」控制點
blocks.en:
PHA: "Scan first" for all potential hazards in early development
FTA: "Trace the root" to find causes when there is a specific serious event
FMEA: "Find the effects" by assessing the impact of each failure mode once the design is mature
HAZOP: "Find deviations" in process system analysis
HACCP: "Guard" the control points when verifying the manufacturing process

blocks.zh: PHA（初步危害分析）在CDMO的應用
blocks.en: PHA (Preliminary Hazard Analysis) in a CDMO

blocks.zh: PHA：新產品引進時的第一道篩網
blocks.en: PHA: the first screen for introducing a new product

blocks.zh: 當CDMO承接新的客戶產品時，在正式開始FMEA或工藝開發之前，PHA提供了一個快速的初步危害掃描框架。
blocks.en: When a CDMO takes on a new client product, before formally starting FMEA or process development, PHA provides a quick framework for a preliminary hazard scan.

blocks.zh: 應用場景：新型mRNA疫苗充填製程的初步危害分析
blocks.en: Application scenario: preliminary hazard analysis of a new mRNA vaccine filling process

blocks.zh: 材料：脂質奈米顆粒（LNP）在特定pH下的不穩定性
blocks.en: Materials: instability of lipid nanoparticles (LNP) at certain pH values

blocks.zh: 設備：低溫充填設備（-20°C）的結冰危害
blocks.en: Equipment: freezing hazards in low-temperature filling equipment (-20°C)

blocks.zh: 環境：充填速度與剪切力對mRNA完整性的影響
blocks.en: Environment: effect of filling speed and shear force on mRNA integrity

blocks.zh: 介面：充填系統與CIP/SIP系統的相容性危害
blocks.en: Interfaces: compatibility hazards between the filling system and the CIP/SIP system

blocks.zh: PHA vs. FMEA：時機差異
blocks.en: PHA vs. FMEA: timing differences

blocks.zh: PHA適合在「設計規格尚未定案」時使用，而FMEA需要已知的組件設計和失效模式。在實際工作流程中：PHA → 危害識別 → FMEA → 失效模式評估 → HACCP → 製程控制點確認。
blocks.en: PHA is suitable when "design specifications are not yet finalized," whereas FMEA requires known component designs and failure modes. In the actual workflow: PHA → hazard identification → FMEA → failure mode evaluation → HACCP → confirmation of process control points.

blocks.zh: B.3 Fault Tree Analysis (FTA) — 故障樹分析
blocks.en: B.3 Fault Tree Analysis (FTA)

blocks.zh: FTA（故障樹分析）：由上而下找根源
blocks.en: FTA (Fault Tree Analysis): finding root causes top-down

blocks.zh: FTA的核心邏輯：「為什麼會發生？」
blocks.en: The core logic of FTA: "Why would it happen?"

blocks.zh: FTA從一個已知的不良結果（頂端事件）開始，逐層向下追問根本原因。
blocks.en: FTA starts from a known adverse outcome (the top event) and asks about root causes level by level going down.

blocks.zh: 邏輯閘的意義：
blocks.en: Meaning of the logic gates:

blocks.zh: AND閘：多個原因同時發生才會導致上層事件 → 機率相乘，風險較低
blocks.en: AND gate: multiple causes must occur simultaneously to cause the upper-level event → probabilities multiply, lower risk

blocks.zh: OR閘：任何一個原因單獨發生就會導致上層事件 → 機率相加，風險較高
blocks.en: OR gate: any one cause occurring alone will cause the upper-level event → probabilities add, higher risk

blocks.zh: CDMO FTA實例：無菌充填失效
blocks.en: CDMO FTA example: failure of aseptic filling

blocks.zh: 頂端事件（Top Event）：患者接受到非無菌藥品
blocks.en: Top Event: the patient receives a non-sterile drug product

blocks.zh: 向下展開（OR閘）：
blocks.en: Expanding downward (OR gate):

blocks.zh: 充填過程中發生微生物污染（OR）
blocks.en: Microbial contamination during filling (OR)

blocks.zh: 最終產品CCI失效（OR）
blocks.en: Final product CCI failure (OR)

blocks.zh: 滅菌製程失效
blocks.en: Sterilization process failure

blocks.zh: 「充填過程中微生物污染」再向下展開（OR閘）：
blocks.en: "Microbial contamination during filling" expanded further (OR gate):

blocks.zh: B級環境超標（OR）
blocks.en: Grade B environment out of limits (OR)

blocks.zh: 操作員無菌技術失誤（OR）
blocks.en: Operator aseptic technique error (OR)

blocks.zh: 充填設備除菌過濾器失效
blocks.en: Failure of the sterilizing filter on the filling equipment

blocks.zh: 「除菌過濾器失效」再向下（AND閘）：
blocks.en: "Sterilizing filter failure" expanded further (AND gate):

blocks.zh: 過濾器破損 AND 完整性測試未執行或未通過驗收標準
blocks.en: Filter breach AND integrity test not performed or failing the acceptance criteria

blocks.zh: 透過AND閘的識別，我們知道過濾器完整性測試是防止這條路徑發生的關鍵控制點。
blocks.en: By identifying the AND gate, we know that the filter integrity test is the key control point that prevents this path from occurring.

blocks.zh: FTA的限制
blocks.en: Limitations of FTA

blocks.zh: 當故障樹非常龐大時，手動分析變得困難，需要電腦輔助工具（如ReliaSoft、Isograph等）。FTA也僅分析已已識別的危害，因此必須與PHA或附錄A的危害識別配合使用。
blocks.en: When the fault tree is very large, manual analysis becomes difficult and computer-aided tools (such as ReliaSoft, Isograph, etc.) are needed. FTA also analyzes only hazards that have already been identified, so it must be used together with PHA or the Annex A hazard identification.

blocks.zh: B.4 Event Tree Analysis (ETA) — 事件樹分析
blocks.en: B.4 Event Tree Analysis (ETA)

blocks.zh: ETA（事件樹分析）：由因推果的二元路徑
blocks.en: ETA (Event Tree Analysis): binary paths from cause to consequence

blocks.zh: ETA應用：電力中斷對無菌充填線的影響
blocks.en: ETA application: impact of a power interruption on an aseptic filling line

blocks.zh: 觸發事件：無菌充填室電力中斷
blocks.en: Initiating event: power interruption in the aseptic filling room

blocks.zh: 事件樹二元展開：
blocks.en: Binary expansion of the event tree:

blocks.zh: UPS是否自動切換？
blocks.en: Does the UPS switch over automatically?

blocks.zh: 成功 → 充填繼續，影響最小化
blocks.en: Success → filling continues, impact minimized

blocks.zh: 失敗 → 繼續分析...
blocks.en: Failure → continue the analysis...

blocks.zh: （UPS失敗後）HVAC是否維持正壓？
blocks.en: (After UPS failure) Does the HVAC maintain positive pressure?

blocks.zh: 成功 → 環境受控，但需評估暴露時間
blocks.en: Success → environment remains controlled, but exposure time must be assessed

blocks.zh: 失敗 → 正壓失效，微生物污染風險
blocks.en: Failure → loss of positive pressure, risk of microbial contamination

blocks.zh: （HVAC失敗後）操作員是否即時執行隔離程序？
blocks.en: (After HVAC failure) Does the operator promptly carry out the isolation procedure?

blocks.zh: 成功 → 批次隔離待調查，損失可控
blocks.en: Success → batch quarantined pending investigation, loss is controllable

blocks.zh: 失敗 → 污染批次可能繼續充填
blocks.en: Failure → the contaminated batch may continue to be filled

blocks.zh: ETA讓我們清楚看到，UPS和緊急應變SOP是防止電力中斷導致患者危害的關鍵防線。
blocks.en: ETA shows us clearly that the UPS and the emergency response SOP are the key lines of defense against patient harm from a power interruption.

blocks.zh: B.5 Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) — 失效模式與效應分析
blocks.en: B.5 Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA)

blocks.zh: FMEA（失效模式與效應分析）：CDMO的核心工具
blocks.en: FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis): the CDMO's core tool

blocks.zh: FMEA的三個關鍵參數
blocks.en: The three key parameters of FMEA

blocks.zh: 在ISO 14971框架下的FMEA通常評估三個維度（注意：ISO 14971本身不規定RPN計算，但業界常用）：
blocks.en: Under the ISO 14971 framework, FMEA usually evaluates three dimensions (note: ISO 14971 itself does not prescribe RPN calculation, but it is commonly used in industry):

blocks.zh: 嚴重性（Severity, S）：失效模式對患者造成傷害的嚴重程度（1–10分）
blocks.en: Severity (S): how serious the harm to the patient is if the failure mode occurs (scored 1-10)

blocks.zh: 發生率（Occurrence, O）：失效模式發生的概率（1–10分）
blocks.en: Occurrence (O): the probability that the failure mode occurs (scored 1-10)

blocks.zh: 可探測性（Detectability, D）：現有控制措施能否在造成傷害前探測到失效（1–10，分數越高越難探測）
blocks.en: Detectability (D): whether existing controls can detect the failure before harm results (1-10; the higher the score, the harder to detect)

blocks.zh: RPN = S × O × D（風險優先數，Risk Priority Number）
blocks.en: RPN = S × O × D (Risk Priority Number)

blocks.zh: 重要提醒：ISO 14971:2019不要求RPN計算。RPN是FMEA工具（如IEC 60812）的概念，但在ISO 14971框架下，嚴重性（S）是最重要的維度——高嚴重性的風險即使發生率低，也必須採取風險控制措施。
blocks.en: Important reminder: ISO 14971:2019 does not require RPN calculation. RPN is a concept from FMEA tools (such as IEC 60812), but under the ISO 14971 framework, severity (S) is the most important dimension: a high-severity risk requires risk control measures even if its occurrence is low.

blocks.zh: 三種FMEA類型在CDMO的應用
blocks.en: Three types of FMEA in a CDMO

blocks.zh: 設計FMEA（Design FMEA）：評估西林瓶/膠塞/針管的設計本身失效模式，適用於容器系統選型階段
blocks.en: Design FMEA: evaluates failure modes of the design itself of the vial / stopper / syringe barrel; applicable at the container system selection stage

blocks.zh: 製程FMEA（Process FMEA）：評估充填、壓塞、軋蓋、凍乾等製造步驟的失效模式，是CDMO最常用的FMEA類型
blocks.en: Process FMEA: evaluates failure modes of manufacturing steps such as filling, stoppering, capping and lyophilization; the most commonly used type of FMEA in a CDMO

blocks.zh: 使用FMEA（Use FMEA）：評估藥品使用者（護士、患者）可能的使用錯誤，對自我注射器材尤為重要
blocks.en: Use FMEA: evaluates possible use errors by users of the drug product (nurses, patients); especially important for self-injection devices

blocks.zh: B.6 Hazard and Operability Study (HAZOP) — 危害與可操作性研究
blocks.en: B.6 Hazard and Operability Study (HAZOP)

blocks.zh: HAZOP（危害與可操作性研究）：用「引導詞」找偏差
blocks.en: HAZOP (Hazard and Operability Study): finding deviations with "guide words"

blocks.zh: HAZOP在無菌充填製程的應用：滅菌節點分析
blocks.en: HAZOP applied to an aseptic filling process: sterilization node analysis

blocks.zh: 製程節點：蒸汽滅菌（高壓滅菌釜）
blocks.en: Process node: steam sterilization (autoclave)

blocks.zh: 設計意圖：121°C / 15分鐘 / F₀ ≥ 12 min
blocks.en: Design intent: 121°C / 15 minutes / F₀ ≥ 12 min

blocks.zh: MORE（溫度過高）→ 藥品降解，包材變形
blocks.en: MORE (temperature too high) → drug degradation, packaging material deformation

blocks.zh: LESS（溫度不足）→ 滅菌失敗，無菌保證水平（SAL）不達標
blocks.en: LESS (temperature insufficient) → sterilization failure, sterility assurance level (SAL) not achieved

blocks.zh: NO（不滅菌）→ 微生物污染，直接患者傷害
blocks.en: NO (no sterilization) → microbial contamination, direct patient harm

blocks.zh: OTHER THAN（錯誤的滅菌程序）→ 使用了乾熱程序替代濕熱，效果不等效
blocks.en: OTHER THAN (wrong sterilization program) → a dry heat program was used in place of moist heat, with non-equivalent effect

blocks.zh: MORE（時間過長）→ F₀值過高，藥品穩定性受損
blocks.en: MORE (time too long) → F₀ value too high, drug stability compromised

blocks.zh: HAZOP在此的優勢：強迫團隊系統性地審視「超出規格」和「低於規格」兩個方向的風險。
blocks.en: The advantage of HAZOP here: it forces the team to systematically examine risks in both directions, "above specification" and "below specification."

blocks.zh: HAZOP的跨領域應用
blocks.en: Cross-disciplinary applications of HAZOP

blocks.zh: HAZOP最初起源於化學工業的製程安全分析。在CDMO環境中，它特別適合分析：
blocks.en: HAZOP originated in process safety analysis in the chemical industry. In a CDMO environment, it is particularly suitable for analyzing:

blocks.zh: 無菌充填線的流體傳輸系統（配液、過濾、充填）
blocks.en: The fluid transfer system of the aseptic filling line (compounding, filtration, filling)

blocks.zh: CIP/SIP系統（清潔滅菌偏差）
blocks.en: CIP/SIP systems (cleaning and sterilization deviations)

blocks.zh: 凍乾製程（各階段溫度/真空偏差）
blocks.en: Lyophilization processes (temperature/vacuum deviations at each stage)

blocks.zh: 環境監控系統（壓差、溫濕度控制偏差）
blocks.en: Environmental monitoring systems (deviations in differential pressure, temperature and humidity control)

blocks.zh: HAZOP引導詞系統
blocks.en: The HAZOP guide word system

blocks.zh: HAZOP的核心在於將「引導詞」應用到每一個製程節點（Process Node），系統性地探索可能的偏差：
blocks.en: The core of HAZOP is applying "guide words" to each process node to systematically explore possible deviations:

blocks.zh: HACCP（危害分析關鍵控制點）：製程控制的系統性保障
blocks.en: HACCP (Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points): systematic assurance of process control

blocks.zh: HACCP的起源與在製藥的轉化
blocks.en: Origin of HACCP and its translation to pharma

blocks.zh: HACCP起源於1960年代NASA的太空食品安全計畫，後廣泛用於食品工業。在製藥CDMO中，HACCP的邏輯與ICH Q10的製藥品質體系（PQS）高度契合：
blocks.en: HACCP originated in the 1960s from NASA's space food safety program and was later widely used in the food industry. In a pharmaceutical CDMO, the logic of HACCP aligns closely with the ICH Q10 pharmaceutical quality system (PQS):

blocks.zh: CCP（關鍵控制點） ≈ CPP（關鍵製程參數, Critical Process Parameter）
blocks.en: CCP (Critical Control Point) ≈ CPP (Critical Process Parameter)

blocks.zh: 關鍵限度 ≈ 製程驗收標準（Process Acceptance Criteria）
blocks.en: Critical limit ≈ Process Acceptance Criteria

blocks.zh: 監控與糾偏 ≈ 即時製程監控（In-Process Monitoring）+ CAPA
blocks.en: Monitoring and corrective action ≈ In-Process Monitoring + CAPA

blocks.zh: HACCP七原則在CDMO的操作步驟
blocks.en: Operational steps of the seven HACCP principles in a CDMO

blocks.zh: 危害分析：使用附錄A問題清單 + PHA識別所有潛在危害，確定顯著危害清單
blocks.en: Hazard analysis: use the Annex A checklist + PHA to identify all potential hazards and establish the list of significant hazards

blocks.zh: 確定CCP：使用判定樹（Decision Tree）判斷哪些步驟是CCP vs. 一般管制點（CP）
blocks.en: Determine CCPs: use a decision tree to judge which steps are CCPs vs. ordinary control points (CP)

blocks.zh: 建立關鍵限度：基於科學（工藝開發數據）+ 法規（USP/Ph.Eur.藥典標準）
blocks.en: Establish critical limits: based on science (process development data) + regulation (USP/Ph.Eur. pharmacopoeial standards)

blocks.zh: 建立監控程序：誰監控？何時監控？如何監控？頻率？
blocks.en: Establish monitoring procedures: who monitors? when? how? at what frequency?

blocks.zh: 建立糾偏措施：偏差發生時的即時處置程序（Deviation SOP）
blocks.en: Establish corrective actions: immediate response procedure when a deviation occurs (Deviation SOP)

blocks.zh: 驗證程序：製程驗證（PV）、持續製程確認（CPV）
blocks.en: Verification procedures: process validation (PV), continued process verification (CPV)

blocks.zh: 文件記錄：批次記錄（BPR）、偏差報告、CAPA記錄
blocks.en: Documentation: batch production records (BPR), deviation reports, CAPA records

blocks.zh: HACCP vs. FMEA：選擇哪一個？
blocks.en: HACCP vs. FMEA: which one to choose?

blocks.zh: 在CDMO實踐中，這兩種工具通常並用，而非互相替代：
blocks.en: In CDMO practice, the two tools are usually used together rather than as substitutes for each other:

blocks.zh: Process FMEA：適合分析每個製程步驟的失效模式，計算RPN，排定改善優先順序
blocks.en: Process FMEA: suited to analyzing the failure modes of each process step, calculating RPN and prioritizing improvements

blocks.zh: HACCP：適合確定製程中的關鍵控制點，建立監控和驗證體系
blocks.en: HACCP: suited to determining the critical control points in the process and establishing the monitoring and verification system

blocks.zh: 常見的工作流程：Process FMEA → 識別高風險步驟 → HACCP → 確立CCP並建立控制計畫
blocks.en: Common workflow: Process FMEA → identify high-risk steps → HACCP → establish CCPs and build the control plan

blocks.zh: 附錄A&B 綜合比較 / Integrated Comparison of Annexes A & B
blocks.en: Annexes A & B: Integrated Comparison

blocks.zh: 完整風險管理流程中附錄A/B的定位
blocks.en: Positioning of Annexes A/B in the complete risk management process

blocks.zh: CDMO整合應用：新無菌充填產品的風險管理計畫
blocks.en: CDMO integrated application: risk management plan for a new aseptic filling product

blocks.zh: 當CDMO承接一個新的單株抗體（mAb）無菌充填項目時，完整的風險管理計畫應涵蓋：
blocks.en: When a CDMO takes on a new monoclonal antibody (mAb) aseptic filling project, the complete risk management plan should cover:

blocks.zh: 月1-2：使用附錄A問題清單進行初始危害識別（特別關注A.2.4材料相容性、A.2.6物質輸送、A.2.8滅菌）
blocks.en: Months 1-2: initial hazard identification using the Annex A checklist (with particular attention to A.2.4 material compatibility, A.2.6 substance delivery, A.2.8 sterilization)

blocks.zh: 月2-3：PHA初步篩選高優先危害；對「蛋白質聚集體」等高嚴重性危害啟動FTA
blocks.en: Months 2-3: PHA to screen high-priority hazards; start FTA for high-severity hazards such as "protein aggregates"

blocks.zh: 月3-6：製程開發期間進行Process FMEA（充填、凍乾、壓塞）；同步進行HAZOP（充填流體系統）
blocks.en: Months 3-6: Process FMEA during process development (filling, lyophilization, stoppering); HAZOP (filling fluid system) in parallel

blocks.zh: 月6-9：製程驗證前完成HACCP關鍵控制計畫；CCP與製程驗證方案（PV Protocol）對齊
blocks.en: Months 6-9: complete the HACCP critical control plan before process validation; align the CCPs with the process validation protocol (PV Protocol)

blocks.zh: 持續：商業化生產後的持續製程確認（CPV）數據回饋FMEA，動態更新風險管理檔案
blocks.en: Ongoing: continued process verification (CPV) data after commercial production feed back into the FMEA, dynamically updating the risk management file
